observations: Three photos show a large, dirty, metallic automotive gearbox lying on a dirt ground.
The gearbox has a cylindrical housing with visible wear, oil stains, and grime.
Various hoses, electrical connectors, and metal fittings are attached to the unit.
A yellow sticker or mark is visible on the top of the gearbox in all photos.
The unit is surrounded by other mechanical parts and a blue plastic crate.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the gearbox in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Direct Belgium Gearbox' for a 'Ford Expedition V8 4WD'.
